> One-click car rental in Batam, with or without a driver. Pickup at the
> Golden office, ferry ports, or Hang Nadim Airport. Sewa mobil di Batam —
> mudah, tanpa ribet.

- Honda Brio (4 seats) — from Rp 300.000/day
- Toyota Avanza Veloz (6 seats) — from Rp 300.000/day

- Toyota Innova Venturer — from Rp 600.000/day
- Toyota Innova Zenix — from Rp 700.000/day

- Toyota Alphard (luxury) — from Rp 2.500.000/day

Booking: pick a car, pick START–END dates (past dates disabled), choose a
pickup point (office, Batam Centre / Harbour Bay / Sekupang / Nongsapura /
Teluk Senimba / Telaga Punggur ferry terminals, or Hang Nadim Airport), and
confirm on WhatsApp. Final price is confirmed on WhatsApp before payment.

## Rental FAQ (full answers carry FAQPage schema on the guide page)

- How much? From Rp 300.000/day (city cars), Innova from Rp 500.000 — final price confirmed before payment, no hidden extras
- GPS and insurance included in every car
- With or without a driver; state your preference on WhatsApp
- Bring a valid ID (passport for Singapore/Malaysia visitors)
- Pickup: Golden office Taman Baloi, 6 ferry terminals, or Hang Nadim Airport
- Booking: pick car + START–END dates + name + pickup, confirm via WhatsApp; no on-site payment

## Where to go in Batam (trending places)

- Barelang Bridge — icon bridge, best at sunset
- Nagoya Food Court — local eats in Nagoya
- Grand Batam Mall — shops, food and a movie
- Ocarina Park — seafront rides incl. Ferris wheel
- Kepri Coral — floating restaurant at sunset
- Montigo Resort Nongsa — infinity pool with Singapore view + private plunge pools
